resources.string: MeshSync keeps the same folder identical on your devices — phone, computer, tablet. Change a file on one and it shows up on the others.
Your devices talk straight to each other, so there is no account and no company server holding your files. Each device has its own code; you pair two devices by sharing that code.
You choose which folders to share and with which devices. Nothing leaves this phone until you say so, and replaced files are kept in a safe copy.
What do you want to do first?
You can always change this later.
Share a folder from this device
Pick a folder here and send it to another device.
Get a folder from another device
Connect to the device that has the files and accept its folder.
